The 76 unmatched are scrolls, mats and quest items; only 6 are plausible level-50+ gear and those are scopes/materials, not equippable slots. Our Worldforged classification is INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED and effectively complete.
_crossCheck.idsDoNotMatchDirectly: LootCollector stores BASE item ids; our catalog stores one id per upgrade tier (e.g. Ancient Dark Iron Mace is 7 ids for ilvl 60/64/70/73/77/81/88). Direct id intersection is only 189 - match by NAME, not id.
_crossCheck.whatItDoesNotHave: No stat data of any kind: no PvE Power, no PvP Power, no per-tier stats. scannerData carries only isCollected, reqLevel and isWF. It is a discovery, location and vendor tracker, so it CANNOT fill the PvE/PvP Power gap. The addon export remains the only source for those.
